question: Please provide a list of the top three revenue-generating films for each actor, along with the average revenue per actor in those films, calculated by dividing the total film revenue equally among the actors for each film.
sql:
-- Full result with rounding for cleanliness
WITH film_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        i.film_id,
        SUM(p.amount) AS total_revenue,
        COUNT(DISTINCT fa.actor_id) AS num_actors
    FROM payment p
    JOIN rental r ON p.rental_id = r.rental_id
    JOIN inventory i ON r.inventory_id = i.inventory_id
    JOIN film_actor fa ON i.film_id = fa.film_id
    WHERE p.rental_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY i.film_id
),
actor_film_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        fa.actor_id,
        fr.film_id,
        fr.total_revenue / fr.num_actors AS actor_film_revenue
    FROM film_actor fa
    JOIN film_revenue fr ON fa.film_id = fr.film_id
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        actor_id,
        film_id,
        actor_film_revenue,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY actor_id ORDER BY actor_film_revenue DESC) AS rn
    FROM actor_film_revenue
),
top3 AS (
    SELECT actor_id, film_id, actor_film_revenue, rn
    FROM ranked
    WHERE rn <= 3
)
SELECT 
    a.actor_id,
    a.first_name,
    a.last_name,
    f.title,
    ROUND(t3.actor_film_revenue, 2) AS actor_film_revenue,
    ROUND(AVG(t3.actor_film_revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY t3.actor_id), 2) AS avg_revenue_per_actor
FROM top3 t3
JOIN actor a ON t3.actor_id = a.actor_id
JOIN film f ON t3.film_id = f.film_id
ORDER BY a.actor_id, t3.rn
